searchText: I actually think the evm refactor would be a great candidate for splitting up. Setup PR, each opcode as a PR, then a cleanup after. But what's done is done 🤣 I think the approach that Sam is modelling in https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/600 is the approach we should take going forward. Refactor the most recent fork, get approval, do the backports, get approval on the backports. I think opcode refactoring should have been a feature branch. I don't understand why the whole refactoring had to be done at once, or why it would benefit from a long term branch. Again, not saying there's anything wrong with the PR as is. It's just a convenient example. I had a strong aversion to the having the format be inconsistent between files. Given we are still in development that probably wasn't rational. Ah, that makes sense. I'd never cut a release part way through something like that Speaking of, we can probably cut a 1.0.0 release soon! Publish on PyPI and all that
